question: At which of the following events did Punjab’s Devansh Jagga break the national record in the Under - 16 Discus Throw Competition ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**37th**____** AFI National Junior Athletics Championship**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The 37th National Junior Athletics Championships 2022 was a significant sporting event held in India.

 
• **Dates:** November 11-15, 2022
 
• **Venue:** SAI Athletics Stadium, Guwahati, Assam
 
• **Organizer:** Athletics Federation of India (AFI)
 
• **Significance:** This championship serves as a platform to identify and nurture young athletic talent in India. It provides a competitive environment for aspiring athletes to showcase their skills and compete at the national level.
 
• **Events:** The championships featured a wide range of track and field events, including sprints, middle-distance and long-distance races, hurdles, relays, jumps (high jump, long jump, triple jump), throws (shot put, discus, javelin), and walks.
 
• **Participants:** Athletes from across India, representing their respective states and union territories, participated in the championships.
 
• **Objectives:**
 
 
• To identify and develop future champions in Indian athletics.
 
• To provide a competitive platform for young athletes to improve their performance.
 
• To promote the growth and development of athletics in India.
 
 
 
• **Outcome:** The championships witnessed impressive performances from young athletes, with many achieving personal bests and setting new records. The event provided valuable experience and exposure to the participating athletes, helping them to further their athletic careers.

The 37th National Junior Athletics Championships 2022 played a crucial role in identifying and nurturing young talent in Indian athletics, contributing to the continued growth and development of the sport in the country.
